name: Haus Tonin
beschreibung: The Haus Tonin is situated in a sunny, central position on Franz-Senn-Weg in Fulpmes in the Stubaital, boasting clear views of the striking Kalkkögel limestone peaks. The welcoming alpine-style guest rooms feature modern en-suite bathrooms with shower/WC, satellite TV, Wi-Fi, and private balconies framing mountain panoramas. A wholesome breakfast made with fresh local ingredients greets visitors every morning. The historic village centre of Fulpmes, complete with traditional inns, shops, and the terminal of the scenic Stubaitalbahn tramway, is an easy stroll away. The base terminal of the popular Schlick 2000 ski and hiking centre is just minutes away by car, with the free ski bus stopping nearby, also connecting directly to the Stubai Glacier.
kurzbeschreibung: Traditional alpine guesthouse on Franz-Senn-Weg in Fulpmes in the Stubaital with cosy rooms and close to Schlick 2000.
